attchmntText: Algoquant Fintech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Algoquant Fintech Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors O P Bagla & Co. LLP. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit before tax of 3,013.77 lakh rupees and a profit for the period of 2,244.79 lakh rupees. Earnings per share were 0.80 rupees. Total assets stood at 37,446.64 lakh rupees as of September 30, 2026. The company also invested 52.50 lakh rupees in its subsidiary, AQ Capital Services Private Limited, through a rights issue.
